issues.description: Method name mismatch: the problem statement and the example Main refer to a static method named acceptSupplyDelivery(String name, int price, int quantity) on SealSaloon, but the solution implements a static method named receiveDelivery(String name, int price, int quantity). This naming inconsistency means code or tests that call acceptSupplyDelivery will not find the implementation in the solution, and students following the statement/Main will implement acceptSupplyDelivery whereas the solution uses receiveDelivery, causing confusion and potential compile/runtime errors.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across all artifacts. Rename the solution's static method receiveDelivery(String, int, int) to acceptSupplyDelivery(String, int, int) (keeping the same parameters, static modifier, and behavior), or alternatively update the problem statement and example Main to call receiveDelivery. Prefer renaming the solution method to acceptSupplyDelivery to match the specification and Main example.

issues.description: The problem statement (UML and text) requires a static SealSaloon method named acceptSupplyDelivery(String, int, int) to register incoming ingredient deliveries to the shared stock. In the reference implementation (solution repository) the equivalent functionality is implemented as a different static method named receiveDelivery(String, int, int). Because the same conceptual operation (registering a supply delivery to the shared stock) is referenced with two different identifiers across artifacts, students reading the problem and then inspecting the reference/template code may search for acceptSupplyDelivery and not find it, or implement acceptSupplyDelivery while the solution/tests use receiveDelivery, creating confusion and extra mapping effort.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the identifiers consistent: rename the solution's public static method receiveDelivery(String, int, int) to acceptSupplyDelivery(String, int, int) (and update any internal calls), or provide a thin wrapper public static acceptSupplyDelivery(...) that delegates to receiveDelivery(...). Update any documentation/tests to use the same name so students can directly map the problem description to the implementation.
